entities.text: High Court Of Gujarat At Ahmedabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The present application is filed by the applicant-State seeking leave to appeal before this Court challenging judgment and order of acquittal dated 20.02.2017 passed by the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Sihor in Criminal Case No. 63/2010, wherein at the end of trial, the learned judge was pleased to acquit respondent for alleged breach of provisions of Section 2(i-a) (a)
(j) (m), Rule 44(c) and 50 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and Rules, 1955 read with Section 7(1), 7(5) and Section 16 of the said Act and therefore, applicant-State of Gujarat begs to prefer leave to appeal alongwith Criminal Appeal under Section 378(1) (3) of Cr.P.C. against order of acquittal.
